description: This file implements the 'Underflow' class, which handles buffer underflow events in a media streaming context. It manages state related to underflow detection, notifies clients of buffer underflow or end-of-stream conditions, and interacts with the media player's context and client interfaces.

classes.name: Underflow
classes.description: Class responsible for handling buffer underflow events, managing state, and notifying clients about underflow or end-of-stream conditions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the underflow handling logic, including checking conditions, updating state, and notifying clients.

methods.name: allSourcesEos
methods.description: Checks if all media sources have reached end-of-stream.
